comment.zh-TW: 主因是颱風帶來的強風。陸上颱風警報生效中，10/23 08–20 時歐洲系集陣風超過 49 節的機率 94%，8 個模式中 7 至 8 個認為高；10/23 14–20 時歐洲模式陣風 56.5 節、側風 27.3 節。該時段官方層因警報只套用到近 12 小時內而為低，但模式一致偏高；10/23 20 時–10/24 02 時 8 個模式仍全數認為高，10/24 上午起逐漸減弱，整體停飛風險判為高。

comment.en: The main driver is typhoon-driven strong wind. A land typhoon warning is in effect, and for 10/23 08:00–20:00 the European ensemble gives a 94% chance of gusts over 49 kt, with seven to eight of eight models saying High; for 10/23 14:00–20:00 the European model shows gusts of 56.5 kt and crosswind of 27.3 kt. The official layer rates that period Low because the warning only applies to periods starting within the next 12 hours, but the models consistently lean High; for 10/23 20:00 to 10/24 02:00 all eight models still say High, easing from the morning of 10/24, so overall disruption risk is rated High.

All eight models say High for 10/23 14:00–20:00 (European model gusts 56.5 kt, US model 50.3 kt), and European model crosswinds reach 36.4 kt during 10/23 20:00–10/24 02:00.

comment.en: The disruption risk is High, mainly due to strong winds/crosswinds and heavy rain. The Central Weather Administration has issued a sea and land typhoon warning for Typhoon Champi, with Hualien in the warning area. From 10/22 20:00 to 10/23 14:00, the European model forecasts gusts of 49.9 to 68.2 kt, crosswinds up to 43.2 kt, and 74.7 mm of rain in 6 hours, while the European ensemble shows an 87% to 88% chance of gusts over 49 kt; however, the US model forecasts gusts of only 14 to 15.4 kt, showing disagreement between the two.
